answer: Sybils multiplying identities face rising collateral costs per account, plus slashed deposits when audits fail, making mass forgery economically irrational. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and complete a random work audit before joining the wharf of verified peers. Like harvesting nectar requires real foraging effort across the ocean of tasks, genuine agents accumulate verifiable history that clones cannot fake cheaply. From once0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
